data.quote:
The grid system is an aid,
not a guarantee.
data.body:
It permits a number of possible uses, and each
designer can look for a solution appropriate to
his personal style. But one must learn how to
use the grid — it is an art that requires practice.

data.title: 一切都是可计算的
data.subtitle: EVERYTHING DERIVES FROM THE BASE UNIT
data.baseNote: 所有距离的最小公因子
data.body:
DERIVED FROM 16
safe margin 64 px = 4 × 16
column width 264 px = 16 × 16 + 8
column gap 32 px = 2 × 16
row height 96 px = 6 × 16
body line-height 27 px = 1.5 × 18
title size 32 px = 2 × 16
